# LaWAM notices

Source is imported from the verified read-only checkout
`RLinf/LaWAM@4ea6fdadce6c9b8746028307a246b79ee2c4fd55`. The upstream root has no
standalone license file, so this directory retains its exact README and
`pyproject.toml` hashes, the declared MIT text, an Apache-2.0 text, and a
per-file license map.

Foundation weights remain governed by their own model repositories:
Qwen3-VL is Apache-2.0, DINOv3 uses the DINOv3 License, and the released LaWAM
LAM/pretrain repositories declare MIT. Their exact revisions, model-card and
license hashes must appear in the immutable asset receipt. No LIBERO,
RoboTwin, or other task-SFT checkpoint is permitted in candidate D.
